integrity: The algebraic classification is proved from coefficient comparison and exact factorization. Both relevant primary full texts were inspected, and a standalone standard-library verifier checks symbolic coefficient identities, collision parameters, span formulas, literature specializations, and deterministic integer evaluations.
limitations: The classification is restricted to two nested triples whose first reduction uses a consecutive pair. It does not classify arbitrary six-leaf reduction trees and does not yield a new interval-length theorem. The minimum-span member itself is explicitly present in the 1999 paper.
title: Classification of nested consecutive-pair six-term square-difference identities
